blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. struggled to keep up with Filipino tennis star Alex Eala, even committing a double fault, during a friendly exhibition match on Tuesday. Meanwhile, Education Secretary Sonny Angara mounted a comeback and scored a point against the world-ranked 21-year-old Filipina. Marcos and Angara joined Eala for a ceremonial tennis match at the Eusebio Gymnasium of Pasig Central Elementary School, where around 1,000 learners and government officials gathered to welcome home the country’s tennis sensation. The President tried his hand at serving against Eala but failed to sustain a rally, and one attempt ended in a double fault. […]...
